## Checklist

Before submitting, please verify:

- [ ] I have searched existing issues/PRs to avoid duplicates

**Note**: Feature requests will be evaluated based on alignment with project goals, IEEE 802.1X-2020 compliance, implementation complexity, and community benefit. Not all requests can be accepted, but we appreciate your input!
